page: Google Cloud Platform t2a-standard-1 is an entry-level ARM-based general purpose server instance powered by an Ampere Altra Neoverse-N1 processor operating at 3.0 GHz. The instance features 1 dedicated vCPU across 1 physical core, paired with 4.0 GB of RAM. Cache allocation includes 64 KB of L1 instruction/data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache. It incorporates hardware AES instruction support for cryptographic functions, though it lacks x86-specific vector extensions like AVX or AMX. There is no bundled local storage or integrated GPU hardware.

In benchmark evaluations, the single-threaded performance of the Ampere Neoverse-N1 architecture places in the average range, achieving a stress-ng single-core score of 1783.48 and a Geekbench single-core score of 1018.0. However, multi-core throughput and overall system throughput remain limited by the single physical core, leading to lower multi-core stress-ng and Geekbench scores. Uncached memory bandwidth reaches 11.99 GB/sec for reads and 7.95 GB/sec for writes. Redis SET performance measures at 1.27 million operations per second, while static web serving throughput reaches 1.38 GB/sec.

The instance provides dedicated ARM compute resources with a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio without relying on burstable CPU credit mechanisms. Tradeoffs include low absolute multi-threaded throughput and lack of local ephemeral storage. This instance is suitable for lightweight microservices, basic web serving, utility workloads, ARM64 development environments, and small-scale caching layers that require dedicated single-core execution.
description: Google Cloud Platform t2a-standard-1 is an entry-level general purpose instance built on the ARM64 Ampere Neoverse-N1 architecture operating at 3.0 GHz. Equipped with 1 dedicated physical vCPU, 4.0 GB of memory, and 32 MB of L3 cache, it delivers a standard 1:4 CPU-to-memory ratio. The processor includes hardware AES support but lacks x86 vector extensions and bundled local storage or GPUs. Benchmarks demonstrate solid single-core efficiency with a stress-ng score of 1783.48 and a single-core Geekbench score of 1018.0. Uncached read memory bandwidth reaches 11.99 GB/sec, while static web serving achieves 1.38 GB/sec. With dedicated core allocation avoiding CPU throttling, t2a-standard-1 provides predictable execution for lightweight microservices, ARM build nodes, edge applications, and low-traffic web services.
